title: Elementary tensor opposite matrix lift identities
statement: For commutative rings R,S, a ring homomorphism f, and finite matrix indices, the explicit tensor opposite lift commutes with coefficient maps, multiplication, and scalar matrices, with scalar quotient c/d.

proof.text: These are the standard map, Kronecker multiplication, transpose inverse, and diagonal scalar identities for matrices, followed by reindexing along finProdFinEquiv.

lean.statement: theorem tensorOppositeMatrixLift_properties {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] {n m : ℕ} (f : R →+* S) (a a' : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin n) R) (b b' : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin m) R) (c d : Rˣ) : tensorOppositeMatrixLift (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map f a) (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map f b) = Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map f (tensorOppositeMatrixLift a b) ∧ tensorOppositeMatrixLift (a * a') (b * b') = tensorOppositeMatrixLift a b * tensorOppositeMatrixLift a' b' ∧ tensorOppositeMatrixLift (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.scalar (Fin n) c) (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.scalar (Fin m) d) = Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.scalar (Fin (n * m)) (c / d)
